notes: εἰ μή -> 'but' is one noncompositional unit headed on the first particle under rule 39; neither particle is left unrepresented and the word is not split across them.
The second attributive article is unrepresented under rule 23, the attributive participle 'lost' keeping its own word.
οἴκου is anarthrous, so its supplied 'the' is a rule 7 helper on the noun under rule 51's anarthrous clause.
